Red-Black Tree Implementation

A production-quality red-black tree implementation with insert, delete, and search operations. The red-black tree is a self-balancing binary search tree that guarantees O(log n) time complexity for all major operations.

Key Features

Self-balancing: Maintains balance through color properties and rotations

Type hints: Full type annotation support

Production quality: Comprehensive docstrings and error handling

Demonstration: Interactive main block showing all operations

Operations

Insert: O(log n) - Adds a new key-value pair while maintaining balance

Delete: O(log n) - Removes a key while maintaining balance

Search: O(log n) - Finds a value by key

In-order traversal: O(n) - Returns sorted key-value pairs

Red-Black Properties

Every node is either red or black

The root is always black

Every leaf (NIL) is black

If a node is red, both its children are black

Every path from root to leaf has the same number of black nodes

Usage Example

```python
from red_black_tree import RedBlackTree

tree = RedBlackTree[int, str]()
tree.insert(5, "five")
tree.insert(3, "three")
value = tree.search(5)  # Returns "five"
tree.delete(3)
items = tree.inorder()  # Returns sorted items
```
